preconditions.description: The length of the array arr is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= arr[i] <= 10**4 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array arr is between 1 and 10^4.

postconditions.description: The length of the returned list is equal to the length of the input array arr.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(return_value[i], int) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the returned list is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == -1 or arr.count(return_value[i]) > arr.count(arr[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each element in the returned list, if it is not -1, it has a greater frequency than the corresponding element in arr.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == -1 or arr.index(return_value[i], i+1) == min(arr.index(x, i+1) for x in arr if arr.count(x) > arr.count(arr[i])))
postconditions.description: For each element in the returned list, if it is not -1, it is the closest element on the right with a greater frequency.
